blocks.html: A periodic inspection of the sidewalk shed shall be performed six months following the last installation, adjustment, or repair inspection required by Section 3307.6.5.7 or 3307.6.5.9, or where no such inspection has occurred within six months, six months following the last periodic inspection. The periodic inspection shall be performed by a qualified person designated by the designer, the permit holder for the shed, or a third party acceptable to both the designer and the permit holder to verify that the sidewalk shed is in a safe condition and is in compliance with drawings and the requirements of this chapter.
